input.quote: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. No title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 13 gives Garman ownership of all IP in the Work "including any Improvements or Modifications thereto" — i.e. the bespoke Modifications (Schedule "D") that Sparkling commissions and pays for — with no licence back beyond the narrow, non-transferable use licence in Section 2. The Agreement contains no ownership provision for Sparkling's data at all, even though Section 4(b) has Garman converting Sparkling's data. That breaches the playbook position that we own what we pay for and retain all rights in our data. Garman's ownership of its pre-existing platform is acceptable, so the redline preserves that while vesting the paid-for Modifications in Sparkling (with a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back to any embedded Garman IP), confirming Sparkling's ownership of its data (including converted data), and excluding joint ownership.

proposal.summary: Limit Garman's ownership to its pre-existing Work, give Sparkling ownership of paid-for Modifications with a licence back to embedded Garman IP, and confirm Sparkling owns its data.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have limited Garman's ownership to its pre-existing Software and Documentation, so that the Modifications and other work product we commission and pay for vest in us (with a perpetual licence back to any Garman IP embedded in them), and we have confirmed that we retain all rights in our data, including data converted under Section 4. Our playbook position is that we own what we fund and everything we put in, with no assignment of our IP or data to the vendor and no joint ownership; if Garman must retain title to modifications of its own code, we can accept a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Modifications for our business instead of the assignment.

ops.newText: Garman is the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Work as it exists independently of this Agreement, including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement. Except as expressly provided in this Agreement, no title to the intellectual property in the Work is transferred to Sparkling by this Agreement.

ops.text: Sparkling is and shall remain the owner of all intellectual property rights in the Modifications and any other work product developed specifically for Sparkling and paid for by Sparkling under this Agreement (collectively, the "Sparkling Deliverables"), and Garman hereby assigns to Sparkling all right, title and interest in the Sparkling Deliverables. To the extent any intellectual property of Garman existing independently of this Agreement is embedded in the Sparkling Deliverables, Garman grants Sparkling a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense such intellectual property as part of the Sparkling Deliverables. Sparkling retains all right, title and interest in Sparkling's data, including data converted pursuant to Section 4, and Garman acquires no rights in such data. No intellectual property is jointly owned under this Agreement.
